name: Bind optional external verification to native QA under one attempt owner

files_create.purpose: Canonical authenticated native-QA mapping and recorded mapping validation; no execution loop.
Closed optional mapping context reusing native QA/artifact semantics; no completion authority from data.
Independent neutral current-source conformance cases for mapping, authority exclusion and recovery.
Exact supported producer/controller and completion boundary, source-only limitations.
Exact interface rendezvous and accepted producer granularity.
Actual captures and role-owned review records.

files_modify.purpose: Reuse existing full-envelope authentication and atomic ledger publication to validate/store typed mapping projection in same authority transition; guard external allocation against native history.
Stable common task reservation lock and native/external history conflict guard; no new budget or capture execution.
Reuse current proof core; public typed QA checks matching recorded authenticated mapping for external-owned tasks.
Index optional module and schema; no implicit activation.
Document optional module and authority limits.
Run exact optional external-native QA regression in existing fixtures_self_test job without runner/permissions/check identity change.

non_goals: No human UI approval semantics supplied by generic envelope; selected typed approval profile required separately.
No HMAC/schema assertion proves execution identity; actual trusted producer/isolation pairing must execute for qualification.
No model calls, release tags, production install or paid campaign from this source contract.
No new controller, attempt ledger, semantic score, caller approval or completion schema.
No edits to installed .nizam, frozen historical corpus or unrelated source packages.
No weakening native QA, required inventories, independent review or mutation authority.
acceptance_requirements: Context, native QA, assessed candidate, each check capture and streams must be covered by full-envelope authenticated artifact descriptors; exclude only context self-reference from its own artifact-mode list.
Context host policy and execution-profile refs must be whole immutable assessed candidate contract/tool inputs, selected before execution; no caller-owned approval or code loading from input data.

Native capture.revision is consumer source-preserving commit, not Agentic tool revision. Producer has exactly native agent_id/session_id fields; driver source/image/tool/isolation identities belong in authenticated execution/profile artifacts.
Native capture.cwd/environment match actual assessed execution root/environment; exact argv/exit/proof kind match independently approved required inventory.
One observed driver invocation uses one external permit; no native capture_command_evidence/_reserve_attempt and no standalone SQLite allocation.
Use existing workflow_assurance proof interpretation, including exact counts/diagnostics and required native verifier/schema membership.
Successful typed mapping is stored as a projection in existing external admission ledger in the same serialized durable transition; no new authority ledger.
Generic admitted alone has no typed mapping and cannot satisfy native governed completion.

Current public validate_qa_proof and existing route/receipt completion consumers require matching recorded mapping for externally owned tasks; canonical pre-admission validation uses a private core proof routine without advancing state.
Native and external first reservations share a stable task lock and inspect existing history. Mixed, corrupt or unknown matching history refuses; no automatic conversion, reset or fallback.

Failures/unknown cleanup remain actual statuses; no new attempt until prior execution reconciled. A rejected malformed proof can be repaired from retained same-run evidence but does not authorize another execution.
Read-only proof validation/discovery creates no new authority record; locks are coordination only.
Neutral tests show current public QA/done/receipt consumers reject a generic external admission without matching authenticated mapping.
Actual optional Agentic adapter pairing remains separately owned and must run at exact source/profile/image pins before A08/A09/J01/C22 qualification.
New schema/API cannot load verifiers or producer plugins from data; actual trusted application code selects producer and complete expected metadata.

Preserve existing unbound native captures in non-Git directories. All native/external task reservations use one fixed environment-independent POSIX coordination directory /tmp/nizam-task-reservations-<effective uid>, outside candidate inventory, keyed by SHA256 of canonical JSON [canonical root path, task id]. Git initialization or ambient HOME/TMPDIR/XDG changes cannot select a second lock.

The private coordination directory must be an existing or exclusively created nonsymlink directory owned by the effective user with mode0700; lock must be nonsymlink regular user-owned mode0600, opened nofollow/close-on-exec, never unlinked by the reservation protocol. Unsafe ownership/mode/path/platform refuses; no permission repair or mutable-environment fallback.

Lock files contain no mode selection, count, budget or completion data; existing native reservations/captures and external permit/admission histories alone determine ownership. Preserve native-before-external, external-before-native, corrupt/unknown history and actual simultaneous first-reservation refusals.

Existing non-Git task-wide retry/ceiling cases pass unchanged. Actual native-first non-Git reservation concurrent with Git initialization/external allocation has only one winner; altered TMPDIR cannot split coordination. Host code or administration outside protocol remains outside lock integrity guarantees.

verification.acceptance_test: Neutral happy/adverse full mapping, no second reservation, mixed-mode race, replay/crash and no generic-admission completion
Existing profile1.1 full-envelope and finite recovery controls
Existing route, capture, finite retry and receipt behavior

evidence_convention: Independent RED before source; exact argv/cwd/source/environment, actual statuses/streams, authenticated descriptor coverage and immutable source identities; no fixture is producer authenticity or human acceptance.

source_identity.requires: accepted current source PR150, not released payload

Offline neutral fixtures; no consumer/provider dependency
